blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation.
By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned.
We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model.
To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy , a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder.
An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor’s future-informed context key–value states conditioning action generation.
With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts.
Beyond task-specific learning, the same latent space supports acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge from diverse in-the-wild instruction-annotated videos.
Pretraining the predictor on DROID video–instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM within our framework yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization.
Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for learning effective WAMs, supporting both direct learning from task-specific demonstrations and the transfer of future-modeling knowledge acquired through predictor pretraining on broader in-the-wild videos.
Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy .
blocks.zh:
世界行动模型将未来视觉状态预测与行动生成结合起来。
通过改造视频生成器或图像编辑模型在规模上预先训练,近代WAM的突出一行既继承了预测知识,也继承了所学习的模型.
我们询问,大规模预测预训所引发的预测性视觉潜在空间能否为有效的WAM学习提供足够的基础,而不会继承一个完整的预先训练的视觉基因模型。
为了回答这个问题,我们提出V-JEPA政策,这是一个简单的框架,在冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的潜在空间上建立一个WAM.
在一个下游的单一阶段,共同从零开始学习一个附有指导条件的未来相对应预测器和一个流量匹配行动专家,而预测器的未来知情环境关键值是行动产生的条件。
V-JEPA政策总参数为0.9B,其中可培训参数为0.6B,实现了具有代表性的WAM和跨LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa-GR1的愿景语言行动基线的竞争性业绩。 将同一下游框架和培训预算下的视觉基础进行比较后,发现V-JEPA的潜在作用比歧视性、重建性和面向视频的替代作用更有效,特别是在分配转变的情况下。
除了针对特定任务的学习外,同样的潜在空间还支持从各种内容丰富的教学附加说明的视频中获取可转让的未来模型知识。
在DROID视频上对预测器进行预先培训(没有动作标签的指令配对),并将它调整成我们框架内的WAM,在下游控制以及分散分配的普及方面产生了巨大的收益。
这些研究结果共同建立了预测性视觉潜力,作为学习有效的WAM的基础,支持从特定任务演示中直接学习,支持通过预测器预先培训获得的未来模型知识在更宽广的网络视频上的转移。
我们的代码可在https://github.com/breez3yong/VJEPA-Policy上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Advanced physical intelligence should endow robots with the capability not only to understand the current scene but also to anticipate how it may change through interaction.
World-action models (WAMs) have thus emerged as a promising paradigm for instantiating this principle by coupling action generation with future visual-state prediction, demonstrating strong task performance and improved generalization to unfamiliar tasks and environments ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Pai et al., 2025 ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
They highlight the value of predictive knowledge for general-purpose robot control.
blocks.zh:
高级的物理智能应使机器人不仅能够理解当前场景,而且能够预测它如何通过互动而改变。
因此,世界行动模式已成为一种大有希望的模式,通过将行动生成与未来的视觉状态预测结合起来,以迅速实现这一原则,显示强有力的任务性能,并改进对不熟悉任务和环境的概括(Zhu等人,2025年;Pai等人,2025年;Liang等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年;Bi等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a年)。
它们突出了预测知识对通用机器人控制的价值.

blocks.en:
A prominent line of work acquires this capability by adapting visual generative models pretrained at scale for effective WAM learning. Video-generation models provide priors over motion and scene evolution learned from large-scale video data ( Pai et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , while image-editing models provide priors over instruction-conditioned visual transformations, mapping a current observation directly to a task-specified target visual state without generating intermediate frames ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Despite these different formulations, both approaches transfer knowledge about how visual states change together with the generative backbone in which that knowledge was learned.
This raises a natural question: Does effective WAM learning require inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model, or can a predictive visual latent space learned at scale provide a sufficient foundation?
blocks.zh:
一个突出的工作领域通过对视觉遗传模型进行大规模调整,以便有效学习WAM,从而获得这种能力。 视频生成模型提供了从大规模视频数据中吸取的动作和场景演化的前传(Pai等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年;Yuan等人,2026年),而图像编辑模型提供了指令性条件视觉转换的前传,将当前观测直接映射到任务特定的目标视觉状态,而不产生中间帧(Black Forest Labs,2025年); Wu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026c.). 尽管有这些不同的配方,两种方法都转让关于视觉状态如何变化的知识,以及了解这种知识的遗传骨干。
这自然提出了一个问题: 有效的WAM学习是否要求继承一个完整的预先训练的视觉基因模型,还是规模上的预测性视觉潜伏空间能否提供足够的基础?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy , a framework that builds a WAM on the predictive latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) .
We jointly learn an instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert directly from task-specific demonstrations.
The predictor follows the vision transformer architecture of the V-JEPA predictor, augmented with cross-attention for instruction conditioning, and combines observed latent tokens with learnable queries at future positions to forecast future visual latents in a single forward pass.
Inspired by recent foundation policies ( Black et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) , our framework adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture with shared attention to combine the future predictor and the action expert.
Context and future queries interact through bidirectional attention, and the resulting layer-wise context key–value states condition the action expert, allowing future modeling to directly shape action generation.
V-JEPA’s large-scale video predictive self-supervised pretraining provides a visual latent space suited to this construction.
With the visual encoder kept frozen and both trainable modules learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, our design directly tests whether a predictive visual latent space learned at scale can provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generator.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们提出了V-JEPA政策,这是一个框架,在冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的预测潜在空间上建立一个WAM(Bardes等人,2024年;Assran等人,2025年;Mur-Labadia等人,2026年)。
我们共同从具体任务演示中直接学习了一位有指导条件的未来适切预测器和一位流动匹配行动专家。
预测器遵循V-JEPA预测器的视觉变压器结构,并辅以对指令调节的交叉注意,将观测到的潜伏物与未来位置的可学习的询问结合起来,以预测单向前行的视觉潜伏物.
在最近的基础政策(Black等人,2024年;Black等人,2025年;Ye等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b)的启发下,我们的框架采用了转换器混合结构,共同关注未来预测器和行动专家的结合。
上下文和未来的查询通过双向关注进行互动,由此产生的层层上下文键 - 值状态使动作专家成为条件,使得未来的模型可以直接塑造动作生成.
V-JEPA的大规模视频预测自我监督预训提供了适合这种构造的视觉潜在空间.
随着视觉编码器在单个下游阶段保持冷冻,两个可训练模块都从零开始学习,我们的设计直接测试在尺度上学习的预测性视觉潜伏空间是否能够为有效的WAM学习提供足够的基础,而不会继承一个完整的预先训练的视觉生成器.

blocks.en:
Beyond learning from task-specific demonstrations, we further investigate whether the same latent space can efficiently absorb general future-modeling knowledge from broad in-the-wild videos and transfer it to downstream control.
Task-specific demonstrations cover only a limited range of behaviors and visual transitions.
We therefore pretrain only the instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor on diverse DROID video–instruction pairs, using future-prediction supervision without action labels while keeping the V-JEPA encoder frozen ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) .
We then transfer the predictor to downstream V-JEPA Policy training, where a freshly initialized flow-matching action expert is learned under the same joint objective and downstream budget.
The latent space is thus tested not only as a foundation for direct WAM learning but also as a reliable substrate for acquiring and transferring more general future-modeling knowledge underlying in-the-wild videos.
blocks.zh:
除了从特定任务演示中学习外,我们进一步调查同样的潜在空间是否能够有效地吸收广泛的内幕视频中的一般未来模型知识,并将其转移到下游控制。
任务特定演示只涵盖有限的行为范围和视觉过渡.
因此,我们只预先对各种DROID视频(指示对)进行附有指导条件的未来适切预测器进行训练,使用没有行动标签的未来预测监督,同时将V-JEPA编码器冻结(Khazatsky等人,2024年)。
然后,我们把预测器转到下游的V-JEPA政策培训中,在同一个共同目标和下游预算中学习了一名新开始的流量匹配行动专家。
因此,潜在的空间不仅被检验为直接WAM学习的基础,而且被检验为获取和转让更普遍的未来模型知识的可靠基础,这些知识是隐藏在模糊的视频中。

blocks.en:
We extensively evaluate V-JEPA Policy on both standard and distribution-shifted simulation benchmarks spanning settings from single-arm manipulation to whole-body control, as well as on a real-world dual-arm platform.
Beyond comparisons with baselines, we also systematically analyze the framework through controlled studies of its visual foundation and encoder scale, context-future interaction and future-modeling supervision, training-compute scaling, and action-free predictor pretraining and transfer.
With 0.9B total parameters, of which only 0.6B are trainable, the one-stage model reaches 97.25% on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023a ) , 79.25% on LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , 50.92% on RoboCasa-GR1 tasks ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) , and 45% on two real-world multi-stage bimanual coordination tasks while remaining competitive with representative WAM and VLA baselines.
Under the fixed downstream framework and training budget, the V-JEPA predictive latent outperforms the discriminative ( Oquab et al., 2024 ; Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , reconstructive ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and video-understanding-oriented alternatives ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , with the performance gaps widening under distribution shifts.
Extending downstream training compute on the same task demonstrations yields diminishing returns in generalization.
Predictor-only pretraining on DROID video–instruction pairs without action label supervision instead raises LIBERO-Plus success rate from 79.25% to 91.50% at the default smaller downstream budget, remarkably surpassing the 81.64% success rate achieved by extended training.
The same pretraining also raises the average real-world success rate from 45% to 80%, demonstrating the effectiveness of predictor pretraining beyond simulation.
These results show that a future-latent predictor can acquire knowledge about physical world evolution from diverse in-the-wild videos and transfer it to downstream control within the same latent space.
blocks.zh:
我们广泛评价V-JEPA政策,从单臂操纵到全身控制以及现实世界双臂平台的标准和分配转换模拟基准。
除了与基线进行比较外,我们还通过对其视觉基础和编码器规模的可控研究、上下文-未来互动和未来模型监督、训练-计算规模以及无动作预测器预训和转让,系统地分析该框架。
由于总参数为0.9B,其中只有0.6B可训练,单级模型在LIBERO(Liu等人,2023a)上达到97.25%,在LIBERO-Plus(Fei等人,2025年)上达到79.25%,在RoboCasa-GR1任务上达到50.92%(Bjorck等人,2025年;Nasirirany等人,2024年),在两个现实世界的多级双级协调任务上达到45%,同时与有代表性的WAM和VLA基线保持竞争力.
根据固定的下游框架和培训预算,V-JEPA预测的潜在业绩超过了歧视性(Oquab等人,2024年;Siméoni等人,2026年),重建性(Wan等人,2025年)和面向视频的替代方案(Yan等人,2026年),在分配转移中,业绩差距不断扩大。
将同一任务示范的下游培训加以扩大,使普遍化的回报减少。
在DROID视频(没有动作标签监管的指令配对)上只接受博士预训,相反,LIBERO-Plus的成功率在默认较小的下游预算中从79.25%提高到91.50%,大大超过了通过扩展培训取得的81.64%的成功率。
同样的预训还将现实世界的平均成功率从45%提高到80%,证明了预测器预训超越模拟的效果.
这些结果表明,一个未来相对的预测器能够从各种闪烁的视频中获得关于物理世界演变的知识,并在同一个潜在空间内将其转移到下游控制.

blocks.en: We highlight the main contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们强调以下主要贡献:

blocks.en: • We introduce V-JEPA Policy , a WAM built on the predictive latent space of a frozen V-JEPA encoder. By jointly learning an instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert from scratch in a single downstream stage, it enables effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. • We conduct extensive cross-benchmark evaluations and controlled analyses of V-JEPA Policy. In particular, matched visual-substrate comparisons under a shared downstream framework and training budget show that V-JEPA’s predictive visual latents yield stronger performance, with more significant gains under distribution shifts. • We demonstrate that predictor-only pretraining on DROID video–instruction pairs without action supervision transfers future-modeling knowledge within the same latent space, substantially improving generalization performance on LIBERO-Plus at the same downstream budget.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出V-JEPA政策,这是一个基于V-JEPA编码器的预测潜伏空间的WAM. 通过在单一的下游阶段从零开始共同学习一个具有教学条件的未来适切预测器和一个流配动作专家,它使得WAM能够有效地学习,而不会继承一个经过预先训练的完整的视觉基因模型。 我们对V-JEPA政策进行广泛的跨基准评价和控制性分析。 特别是,在共同的下游框架和培训预算下,对应的视觉-底物比较表明,V-JEPA的预测视觉潜质能产生更强的性能,在分配变化中取得更大的收益。 我们证明,只有预测者才能对DROID视频进行预训,而无需行动监督的指令对将未来的模型知识转移到同一潜在空间,从而大大改善了LIBERO-Plus在同样下游预算上的通用性。

In this section, we first describe future-latent prediction (Sec. 3.1 ) and its coupling with action generation (Sec. 3.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Instruction-Conditioned Latent Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.1 指令性规定

blocks.en:
A fixed visual space. We use the frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to encode the observed context and define the future latent targets ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) .
To match the encoder’s temporal tubelet size of two, we form a minimal two-frame observed context for each camera view by pairing the current frame with an earlier observation.
During training, we combine this context with the corresponding future observations 𝐨 t + \mathbf{o}_{t}^{+} to form a complete video clip.
Following the construction of context and target representations in V-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2025 ) , we designate its future tubelet positions as the masked region.
The context path thus removes tokens at future positions before the Transformer blocks of the encoder, and encodes only observed tokens.
The target path instead processes the complete unmasked clip with the same frozen encoder. We normalize its output tokens across the feature dimension and select the future positions as prediction targets.
We independently encode each camera view and concatenate their context representations and future targets across views to form 𝐙 t c \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{c} and 𝐙 t + \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{+} , respectively.

Future-query prediction. The predictor P ϕ P_{\phi} follows the V-JEPA 2 predictor architecture ( Assran et al., 2025 ) and is trained from scratch to predict the future latent targets.
We project 𝐙 t c \mathbf{Z}_{t}^{c} to the predictor’s hidden dimension and concatenate the result with future-query tokens Δ t + \Delta_{t}^{+} . These query tokens repeat a single learnable mask embedding at all future target positions.
Bidirectional self-attention jointly updates both groups, allowing context states to incorporate information from the evolving future-query representations.

Context tokens retain the positions of the observed input, while future-query tokens use the positions of their prediction targets.

4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
JEPA. Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn visual representations by predicting target embeddings from partial observations, progressing from image representation learning to video prediction and dense video features ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) .
For robot control, DINO-WM ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and action-conditioned V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) learn dynamics in pretrained feature spaces for planning.
VLA-JEPA ( Sun et al., 2026 ) integrates latent prediction with a pretrained vision-language backbone, while JEPA-WAM ( Lin et al., 2026 ) uses a Qwen-initialized predictor with an additional vision–language alignment stage before robot-policy training.
Our default framework instead jointly learns the future predictor and action expert from scratch using a frozen predictive visual encoder in a single downstream stage.
We further study how this latent space supports acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge through predictor-only pretraining on in-the-wild action-free data.
blocks.zh:
JEPA (美国英语). 联合嵌入式预测架构通过预测从部分观测中嵌入的目标,从图像表现学习到视频预测和密集视频特征来学习视觉表现(Asran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年;Asran等人,2025年;Mur-Labadia等人,2026年).
对于机器人控制,DINO-WM(周 al等人,2024年)和动作条件的V-JEPA 2(Asran等人,2025年)在预训的特征空间学习动力学以进行规划.
VLA-JEPA(Sun等人,2026年)将潜伏的预测与预先训练的视觉语言主干结合,而JEPA-WAM(Lin等人,2026年)则在机器人政策培训前使用一个带有额外视觉-语言调和阶段的20初始预测器.
我们的默认框架 联合学习未来的预测器和行动专家 从零开始 在一个下游阶段使用一个冷冻的预测器 视觉编码器。
我们进一步研究这一潜在空间如何支持通过对零星无动作数据的预训,获取可转让的未来模型知识。

blocks.en:
World-action models. Recent WAMs acquire predictive priors by adapting pretrained video generators or image-editing models for control ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
Joint video-action modeling studies explore how visual prediction should interact with action
learning ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
FastWAM further shows that future co-training can improve policy representations even when future imagination is removed at deployment ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches establish several ways to use predictive knowledge while retaining pretrained generative backbones.
Our study examines the inherited visual foundation: whether the latent space learned through predictive pretraining can support effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete visual generator.
blocks.zh:
世界行动模式。 近期的WAM通过调整预先训练的视频发电机或图像编辑模型获取预测前科,用于控制(梁等人,2025年;金等人,2026年;叶等人,2026年;袁等人,2026年;张等人,2026年c).
联合视频行动模型研究探讨视觉预测应如何与行动互动
学习(Wu等人,2024年;Zhu等人,2025年)。
FastWAM进一步表明,未来的共同培训即使部署时消除了未来的想象力,也能改善政策表述(袁等人,2026年).
这些方法确立了使用预测性知识的几种方法,同时保留了事先受过训练的基因骨干。
我们的研究研究了传承的视觉基础:通过预测性预训所学到的潜在空间是否能够支持有效的WAM学习而不会继承一个完整的视觉生成器.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate V-JEPA Policy across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation to investigate four central questions: (Q1. Viability) Can effective WAMs be learned directly on frozen predictive visual latents without inheriting a visual generator? (Q2. Visual Foundation) How does the choice of pretrained visual latent space affect downstream performance and generalization? (Q3. Knowledge Transfer) Can the same latent space support acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge from broader video–language experience? (Q4. Efficiency) How does V-JEPA Policy compare with representative WAMs in inference efficiency?
blocks.zh: 我们通过模拟基准和现实世界的操纵来评价V-JEPA政策,以调查四个核心问题:(问题1.可行性) 有效的WAM能否直接在不继承视觉生成器的情况下在冷冻的预测视觉潜质上学习? (问题2. 视觉基金会) 预试视觉潜伏空间的选择如何影响下游的性能和泛化? (问题3. 知识转让) 同样的潜在空间支持能否从更广泛的视频-语言经验中获得可转让的未来模型知识? (问题4. 效率) V-JEPA政策如何与有代表性的WAM的推论效率进行比较?

blocks.en: 5.2 Learning WAMs without a Pretrained Visual Generator
blocks.zh: 5.2 学习没有经过预先培训的视觉发电机的WAM

blocks.en:
We evaluate whether effective WAMs can be learned directly on frozen predictive visual latents by jointly training the future predictor and action expert from scratch on downstream demonstrations.
Here we also report a variant initialized with a predictor pretrained on DROID video–instruction pairs without action labels, whose pretraining protocol and transfer benefits are examined in Sec. 5.4 .
Neither variant uses action-supervised policy pretraining.

Results on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus. Table 1 summarizes the results on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus.
We train on LIBERO for 10 epochs, intentionally matching the number of downstream training epochs used by FastWAM and ImageWAM. V-JEPA Policy achieves a 97.3% average success rate, remaining close to the larger generator-based WAMs and competitive with representative VLAs, which introduce additional embodied policy pre-training with action labels.
This performance is obtained with only 0.9B policy parameters and no action-supervised policy pretraining.

The same policy also generalizes beyond the original LIBERO evaluation distribution.
Without additional fine-tuning on perturbed demonstrations, it reaches a 79.3% overall success rate on LIBERO-Plus, substantially outperforming FastWAM and remaining competitive with action-pretrained VLA baselines.
ImageWAM retains a higher aggregate success rate, but the results show that competitive robustness can also be learned on frozen predictive visual latents without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model.

Results on real-world manipulation. Finally, we test whether V-JEPA Policy remains physically feasible under real-world dynamics.
On a four-view TianJi Marvin dual-arm platform, we evaluate five methods across two multi-stage manipulation tasks— Table Cleanup and Saucer Racking .

blocks.en: 5.3 The Visual Foundation for WAM Learning
blocks.zh: 5.3 WAM学习视觉基金会

blocks.en:
To answer Q2 , we investigate whether the choice of pretrained visual latent space influences WAM learning when the downstream prediction-control interface remains unchanged.
We therefore compare frozen visual encoders while keeping the predictor and action-expert backbones, downstream demonstrations, and optimization budget fixed.
To ensure a controlled comparison across heterogeneous visual foundations, we use the same raw video segments and align the resulting latent structures across encoders.
Each encoder receives inputs sampled according to its native patch size and temporal compression ratio, while the resulting context latents and future prediction targets are matched in spatial grid size and temporal token length.
The corresponding action chunks and labels remain identical across encoders. Encoder-specific projection layers only accommodate differences in latent feature dimensions without modifying the shared downstream WAM architecture.
blocks.zh:
为了回答问题2,我们调查在下游预测-控制界面保持不变时,选择预先训练的视觉潜在空间是否影响WAM学习.
因此,我们比较冷冻的视觉编码器,同时保留预测器和行动专家骨干,下游演示,优化预算。
为确保对各种视觉基础进行有控制的比较,我们使用相同的原始视频段,并使由此产生的潜在结构与编码器一致。
每个编码器都收到根据其原生补丁大小和时间压缩比取样的投入,而由此产生的上下文潜伏和未来的预测目标则以空间网格大小和时间符号长度相匹配.
相应的动作块和标签在编码器之间仍然相同。 编码器特定投影层只容纳潜在特征维度的差异,而不修改共享的下游WAM架构.

blocks.en:
Comparing visual foundations. Across discriminative, reconstructive, video-understanding-oriented, and predictive representations, all evaluated encoders support downstream WAM learning, but predictive visual latents achieve the strongest overall performance under the shared recipe.
V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L reaches 97.25% on LIBERO and 79.25% on LIBERO-Plus, with the advantage becoming substantially larger under distribution shifts.
Compared with the strongest discriminative baseline DINOv2, the margin increases from 2.35 points in-distribution to 12.23 points under shifts.
The comparison further reveals different generalization capabilities across representation families.
Discriminative and video-understanding-oriented representations remain competitive on appearance-related variations, reflecting their strong sensitivity to visual semantics.
In contrast, reconstructive latents exhibit substantially weaker robustness under LIBERO-Plus shifts, possibly because reconstruction objectives prioritize preserving appearance-level details that are less aligned with the object-centric and temporal abstractions required for robust control.
Overall, these results suggest that predictive visual latents provide a more compatible foundation for robust WAM learning under a unified downstream interface.
blocks.zh:
比较视觉基础. 所有被评价的编码器都支持WAM下游学习,但预测视觉潜伏在共同食谱下实现最强的整体性能。
V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L在LIBERO上达到97.25%,在LIBERO-Plus上达到79.25%,在分配转移中,其优势显著扩大。
与最强的歧视性基线DINov2相比,比值从2.35分分配增加到12.23分。
比较还显示,各代表家庭的通用能力不同。
歧视性和面向视频的表达方式在与外观相关的变异上仍然具有竞争力,反映了其对视觉语义的强烈敏感性.
与此相反,重建潜伏在LIBERO-Plus变换下表现出的强性明显弱,可能是因为重建目标优先考虑保存外观层次的细节,而这些细节与严格控制所需的以物体为中心的时间抽象概念不太一致。
总体而言,这些结果表明,预测的视觉潜伏为在统一的下游界面下进行强健的WAM学习提供了更加兼容的基础.

blocks.en:
Predictive representation quality and scale. Within predictive visual foundations (Table 4 ), we further examine how representation quality and encoder capacity affect downstream WAM learning.
Upgrading from V-JEPA 2 to V-JEPA 2.1 consistently improves LIBERO-Plus robustness across both ViT-L and ViT-G scales, with larger gains under distribution shifts.
In contrast, increasing encoder size from ViT-L to ViT-G primarily benefits in-distribution performance, while providing limited or even negative gains under LIBERO-Plus shifts.
Notably, V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L achieves the strongest LIBERO-Plus performance despite using a smaller backbone than ViT-G.
These results suggest that improvements in predictive representation learning are a more reliable path toward robust WAMs than scaling visual capacity alone with fixed downstream data.
blocks.zh:
预测性代表性质量和规模。 在预测视觉基础上(表4),我们进一步审查表现质量和编码能力如何影响下游WAM学习。
从V-JEPA 2升级为V-JEPA 2.1 不断提高LIBERO-Plus在ViT-L和ViT-G两个尺度的稳健性,在分配变化中收益较大。
相比之下,从ViT-L到ViT-G的编码器尺寸增加,主要有利于分配中的性能,同时在LIBERO-Plus转换下提供有限甚至负收益.
值得注意的是,V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L尽管使用比ViT-G小的骨干,但取得了最强的LIBERO-Plus性能.
这些结果表明,在预测性表现学习方面的改进,比仅用固定的下游数据来扩大视觉能力,更可靠地实现强有力的WAM。

blocks.en:
Role of future prediction. We further isolate the role of explicit future-latent supervision from the contribution of the future-query pathway.
With the visual foundation and downstream recipe fixed, we compare the full model against two ablations: a context-only variant that removes future queries, and a no-future-loss variant that retains the same future-query pathway but removes future-latent supervision.
Both ablations degrade performance on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the no-future-loss variant failing to recover the full model despite preserving the future-query architecture.
This indicates that the gains do not arise merely from expanding the predictor pathway, but from explicitly learning future visual representations that are coupled to downstream action generation.
Detailed configurations and numerical results are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
未来预测的作用。 我们进一步将明确的未来监督的作用与未来至上之路的贡献隔离开来。
随着视觉基础和下游食谱的固定,我们比较了完整的模型与两个杂乱无章的:一个只有上下文的变体可以去掉未来的询问,另一个是没有未来损失的变体,它保留着相同的未来清流路径,但去掉了与未来相适应的监管.
在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上,两种喷雾都降解了性能,虽然保留了未来的清流建筑,但是没有未来损失的变体未能恢复完整的模型.
这表明,收益不仅来自扩展预测器路径,还来自明确学习未来视觉表现,这些表现与下游行动生成相结合。
附录D提供了详细的配置和数字结果。

blocks.en: 5.4 Acquiring and Transferring Future-Modeling Knowledge
blocks.zh: 5.4 获取和转让未来示范知识

blocks.en:
To investigate whether the same predictive latent space supports acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge,
we pretrain only the instruction-conditioned predictor on DROID video–instruction pairs ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) using future-latent supervision.
The visual encoder remains frozen, and pretraining involves neither action labels nor an action expert.
We use the resulting weights to initialize the predictor for downstream joint training alongside a randomly initialized action expert.
blocks.zh:
为了调查同一预测性潜在空间是否支持获取可转让的未来模型知识,
我们只预训DROID视频上的带指导条件的预测器——指令对(Khazatsky等人,2024年),利用未来与时俱进的监督.
视觉编码器仍然冷冻,预训既不涉及动作标签,也不涉及动作专家.
我们利用由此产生的权重来初始化下游联合训练的预测器与随机初始化的行动专家.

blocks.en:
Transfer across benchmarks and distribution shifts. Under matched downstream protocols, predictor-only pretraining improves success across all three simulated benchmarks and both real-world tasks (Table 2 ).
The improvement is modest on in-distribution LIBERO but substantially larger on LIBERO-Plus, where success rises from 79.25% to 91.50% without fine-tuning on perturbed demonstrations.
Improvements are observed across all seven perturbation axes, with the largest gains under language, texture, and robot initial state shifts (Figure 2 (b)).
Positive transfer to RoboCasa-GR1 and physical bimanual manipulation further indicates that future-modeling knowledge acquired without action supervision remains useful across robot embodiments.
blocks.zh:
跨基准转移和分配转移。 根据相应的下游协议,只进行预测的预训可以提高所有三项模拟基准和现实世界任务的成功率(表2)。
在LiBERO-Plus的分布方面,改进幅度不大,但在LiBERO-Plus方面则要大得多,因为在那里,成功率从79.25%上升到91.50%,而没有对扰动的示威进行微调。
在所有七个扰动轴上都观察到改进,在语言、纹理和机器人初始状态变换(图2(b))。
积极转让给RoboCasa-GR1和身体双人操纵进一步表明,在没有行动监督的情况下获得的未来模型化知识在机器人身上仍然有用。

blocks.en:
Transfer beyond downstream optimization. To test whether longer downstream training can recover the transfer gains, we extend a scratch run to 60k optimizer updates while keeping the model, dataset, and batch size fixed (Figure 2 (a)).
Performance improves initially but shows diminishing gains later on both LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, remaining below the performance obtained with pretrained initialization.
On LIBERO-Plus, pretrained initialization achieves 91.50% success rate (SR) after 10-epoch downstream updates, compared with 81.64% after 60k updates from scratch.
Thus, additional task-specific optimization does not recover the gains from predictor pretraining along the evaluated training trajectory.
blocks.zh:
转移超越下游优化. 为了测试更长时间的下游训练是否能够收回转移收益,我们把抓取运行扩展到60k优化器更新,同时保持模型,数据集和批量大小固定(图2(a)).
初期业绩有所改善,但后来LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus的成绩都在下降,仍然低于通过预先训练的初始化获得的成绩。
在LIBERO-Plus上,经过预训的初始化在10个划时代的下游更新后实现了91.50%的成功率(SR),而从零开始的60k更新后则达到了81.64%.
因此,针对具体任务的额外优化无法恢复在经过评价的培训轨迹上从预测器预训中获得的收益。

blocks.en: Together, these results demonstrate that a frozen predictive latent space not only supports direct WAM learning, but also provides a reusable substrate for acquiring and transferring future-modeling knowledge from broader video–language experience.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同表明,一个冷冻的预测潜伏空间不仅支持WAM的直接学习,而且为从更广泛的视频-语言经验中获得和转移未来模型知识提供了一个可重复使用的底板。

blocks.en: 5.5 Deployment Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.5 部署效率

blocks.en: Table 6: Action-prediction core profile on an RTX 4090.

blocks.en:
To address Q4 , we compare the deployment efficiency of V-JEPA Policy with those of FastWAM, a representative WAM, and other baselines.
A key design choice of V-JEPA Policy is to perform future prediction in latent space: a single predictor forward pass produces the future-informed context interface used by the action expert, avoiding iterative visual generation at deployment.
We benchmark the action-prediction core under a matched three-view setting on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with batch size 1, excluding sensor I/O and motor execution latency (as detailed in Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
为了解决问题4,我们将V-JEPA政策的部署效率与代表WAM的FastWAM和其他基线的部署效率进行比较。
V-JEPA政策的主要设计选择是在潜在空间进行未来预测:一个单一的预测器前传产生行动专家使用的未来知情上下文界面,避免部署时的迭代视觉生成.
我们以一个对应的三景设定为基准,在装有1号批量尺寸的NVIDIA RTX 4090上设定行动预测核心,不包括传感器I/O和运动执行延迟(详见附录F)。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 6 , V-JEPA Policy achieves a substantially smaller memory footprint among the evaluated WAMs, requiring only 4.66 GiB peak VRAM.
Compared with FastWAM, which also avoids pixel-space decoding during deployment but retains a large visual generative backbone, V-JEPA Policy reduces peak memory usage by 63.4% and
achieves lower inference latency (178.17 ms vs. 202.51 ms).
These results show that predictive latent WAMs can preserve future-conditioned action generation while avoiding the deployment overhead associated with large generative visual models.
blocks.zh:
如表6所示,V-JEPA政策在经过评估的WAM中实现的记忆足迹要小得多,只需要4.66 GiB峰值VRAM.
与FastWAM(在部署期间也避免像素空间解码,但保留了大型的视觉基因骨干)相比,V-JEPA政策将峰值内存使用率降低了63.4%,
实现较低的推论延迟(178.17 ms对202.51 ms).
这些结果表明,预测性潜在WAM可以保持未来有条件的动作生成,同时避免与大型基因视觉模型相关的部署间接费用。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We showed that effective WAM learning can build on the latent space of a frozen predictive visual encoder without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generator.
V-JEPA Policy instantiates this approach by jointly training a future predictor and an action expert from scratch, coupled through future-informed context states.
The resulting compact policy achieves competitive simulation performance and supports real-world bimanual manipulation.
Controlled encoder comparisons favor predictive visual latents, particularly under distribution shifts.
Predictor-only pretraining on DROID video–instruction pairs without using action labels further improves downstream control and robustness, with LIBERO-Plus gains that extended scratch training does not recover within the evaluated budget.
Together, these findings support predictive visual latents as a sufficient foundation for learning WAMs directly from task-specific demonstrations and acquiring transferable future-modeling knowledge from broader video experience.
blocks.zh:
我们显示,有效的WAM学习可以建立在冷冻的预测视觉编码器的潜在空间上,而不会继承一个完整的预先训练的视觉生成器.
V-JEPA( 日本) 政策通过从零开始联合培训一名未来的预测者和一名行动专家,同时通过掌握未来情况的国家,对这种做法进行迅速培训。
由此产生的紧凑政策实现了竞争性模拟性能,支持现实世界双人操纵.
受控编码器比较倾向于预测视觉潜质,特别是在分布转移时.
在DROID视频-不使用动作标签的指令配对上只进行博士前预训,这进一步改善了下游的控制和稳健性,而LIBERO-Plus增益延长的刮伤训练在评估的预算范围内无法恢复.
这些调查结果共同支持预测的视觉潜力,作为直接从特定任务演示中学习WAM和从更广泛的视频经验中获取可转让的未来模型知识的充分基础。

blocks.en: We evaluate V-JEPA Policy on three simulation benchmarks: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1, which assess in-distribution manipulation, robustness to controlled distribution shifts, and upper-body humanoid tabletop manipulation, respectively.

LIBERO. We evaluate on all 40 tasks across the LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal, and LIBERO-Long suites ( Liu et al., 2023a ) .
For training, we use a mixed-suite dataset containing 1,693 demonstrations, obtained by excluding trajectories that fail when replayed in the simulator from the original LIBERO demonstrations ( Black et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025 ) .
We evaluate each task over 50 episodes and average the resulting task success rates across the ten tasks in each suite.

利贝罗。 我们评价LIBERO-空间、LIBERO-Object、LIBERO-GOAL和LIBERO-Long套房(Liu等人,2023a)的所有40项任务。

blocks.en:
LIBERO-Plus. LIBERO-Plus extends LIBERO with 10,030 perturbed tasks spanning seven categories: camera viewpoints, robot initial states, language instructions, lighting conditions, background textures, sensor noise, and object layouts ( Fei et al., 2025 ) .
We evaluate the same policy trained on LIBERO on the full LIBERO-Plus test set, without further fine-tuning.

利贝罗普卢斯。 LIBERO-Plus将LIBERO扩展为10,030个扰动任务,涉及7个类别:相机视距,机器人初始状态,语言指令,照明条件,背景纹理,传感器噪音,以及物体布局(Fei等人,2025年).

我们报告每个类别的成功率和所有任务的总体成功率。

RoboCasa-GR1. RoboCasa-GR1 is a simulation tabletop manipulation benchmark for the GR-1 humanoid robot, comprising 18 object-rearrangement tasks and six multi-step tasks involving articulated fixtures such as cabinets, drawers, and microwaves ( Bjorck et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en:
Training recipe. We keep the V-JEPA 2.1 visual encoder and T5-XXL text encoder frozen throughout training, and jointly optimize the future predictor and action expert on downstream tasks.
We use AdamW with a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a linear warm-up over the first 5% of scheduled steps, and subsequent cosine decay.
On LIBERO, we train jointly on the four suites for 21,360 optimizer steps, corresponding to ten epochs, with a global batch size of 128.
The model uses two independently encoded 224 × 224 224\times 224 camera views and 32-step action chunks.
On RoboCasa-GR1, we train on all 24 task datasets, each containing 1,000 episodes, for 50,000 steps with a global batch size of 256.
The model uses a single 224 × 224 224\times 224 egocentric view and 16-step action chunks.
For real-world experiments, we train a separate model for each of the two tasks using four camera views resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 .
Both tasks use 32-step action chunks and a global batch size of 64, with 60,000 steps for Table Cleanup and 40,000 steps for Saucer Racking .
For the pretrained-predictor variant, we first train only the future predictor on DROID for 100,000 steps with a global batch size of 192.
This stage uses videos, language instructions, and proprioceptive states, without action labels or an action expert.
We use two camera views resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 and ten-frame clips consisting of one context tubelet and four future tubelets.
For downstream adaptation, we transfer only the pretrained predictor weights and initialize the action expert from scratch.
blocks.zh:
培训食谱。 V-JEPA 2.1视觉编码器和T5-XXL文本编码器在整个培训过程中一直冻结,并共同优化未来下游任务的预测器和行动专家。
我们使用 AdamW 的峰值学习率是 10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 , 线性温暖 超过最初5%的预定步骤, 以及随后的 余弦衰变。
在LIBERO上,我们联合在四个套房上训练21,360个优化步骤,对应十个纪元,全球批量尺寸为128个.
该模型使用两个独立编码的224x224/224\times 224相机视图和32步动作块.
在RoboCasa-GR1上,我们对所有24个任务数据集进行培训,每个数据集包含1000集,为5万步,全球批量大小为256个.
该模型使用一个单一的224×224/224\times 224 自我中心视图和16步动作块.
对于现实世界的实验,我们用四个相机视图调整为256×256256\times 256,为两个任务中的每个任务训练一个单独的模型.
两个任务都使用32步动作块和64个全球批量大小,其中6万步用于清理表格,4万步用于Saucer Racking。
对于预训预导变体,我们首先只在DROID上训练未来预测器10万步,全球批量大小192.
这个舞台使用视频,语言指示,以及自制状态,没有动作标签或动作专家.
我们使用两个摄像头的视线调整为256×256256\times 256和10帧的夹片,由1个上下文管和4个未来管组成.
对于下游的适应,我们只转移预先训练的预测器重量,并从零开始初始化动作专家.

blocks.en: Fine-Tuning Scope and Hyperparameters. To reflect practical deployment, each method follows its native task-tuning schedule rather than an artificial compute-matched budget: V-JEPA Policy is fine-tuned with a batch size of 64 over 60k steps ( Table Cleanup ) and 40k steps ( Saucer Racking ), while baselines use a batch size of 32 over 100k and 40k steps, respectively. blocks.en:
Comparison protocol. We compare frozen visual encoders using the same predictor and action-expert backbones, downstream demonstrations, global batch size of 128, and 21360 optimizer updates.
The predictor and action expert are initialized from scratch, while the visual encoder remains frozen throughout downstream training.
The evaluated foundations include discriminative features from DINOv2 and DINOv3, reconstructive latents from WAN2.2 VAE, video-understanding features from InternVideo3, and predictive features from V-JEPA 2 and V-JEPA 2.1.
Within the predictive family, we compare both encoder generations at ViT-L and ViT-G scales.

比较协议。 我们用同样的预测器和行动专家骨干、下游演示、128个全球批量大小和21360个优化器更新来比较冷冻的视觉编码器。

评估的基金会包括DINOv2和DINOv3的歧视性特征、WAN2.2 VAE的重建潜质、InternVideo3的视频理解特征、V-JEPA 2和V-JEPA 2.1的预测特征。
在预测的家族中,我们比较了维T-L和维T-G尺度的编码器世代.

blocks.en:
Latent interfaces. Each encoder provides observed-context representations and future prediction targets in its own latent space.
Encoder-specific input and output projections accommodate differences in visual feature width while preserving the predictor’s Transformer backbone.
The ViT-L variants of V-JEPA and DINO produce 1024-dimensional features, whereas WAN2.2 VAE and InternVideo3 produce 48- and 1152-dimensional features, respectively.
The action-expert architecture is unchanged across configurations.
Parameter counts in Table 4 include only the frozen visual encoder.
blocks.zh:
Latent 接口. 每个编码器都在其潜伏空间提供可观测到的文字表述和未来预测目标.
编码器特有的输入和输出预测在保留预测器的变形器主干线的同时,能容纳视觉特征宽度的差异.
V-JEPA和DINO的VIT-L变体产生1024维特性,而WAN2.2 VAE和InternVideo3则分别产生48维和1152维特性.
行动专家架构在各种配置中保持不变。
表4中的参数计数只包括冷冻的视觉编码器。

blocks.en:
Input alignment. Following Sec. 5.3 , we adjust spatial resolution and frame sampling within the same raw video segments to match the spatial patch grid and temporal token length across encoders, separately for observed context and future targets. blocks.en: Appendix F Action-Prediction Inference Profiling Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录F 分析议定书

blocks.en:
Benchmarking Setup and Boundary Conditions. Latency and memory profiles are measured on a dedicated local workstation equipped with a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU (batch size 1).
To isolate representation and model architectures from external hardware and pipeline variation, each model receives identical synthetic inputs matching our three-view setup (head, left wrist, right wrist).
Measurements are gathered across 3 independent OS processes per architecture; each process executes 10 warmup iterations followed by 100 recorded calls, yielding 300 timed runs in total with background telemetry disabled.
blocks.zh:
基准设置和边界条件。 延迟和内存剖面在配备单个NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU(批量尺寸1)的专用局部工作站上进行测量.
为了将表现和模型架构与外部硬件和管道变异隔离开来,每个模型都得到与我们三视设置(头,左腕,右腕)相匹配的相同的合成输入.
在每个架构中收集到3个独立的操作系统流程的测量数据;每个流程执行10个热迭代,然后是100个有记录的呼叫,总共产生300个时间运行,背景遥测功能被禁用。

blocks.en:
Crucially, this protocol isolates the action-prediction inference and explicitly factors out pipeline overheads:
(1) I/O and preprocessing : camera RTSP acquisition, image decoding, resizing, and host-to-device transfers;
(2) Control and post-processing : inter-process IPC, action denormalization, temporal ensembling queue updates, and One-Euro filtering; and
(3) Actuator communication : network packet serialization and low-level motor bus latency.
blocks.zh:
关键是,这项协议将行动预测推论隔离开来,并明确将输油管的间接费用考虑在内:
(1) I/O和预处理:摄像机RTSP的获取、图像解码、再大小和主机对设备的传输;
(2) 控制和后处理:进程间IPC、动作非正常化、时间共聚队列更新和1欧元过滤;以及
(3) 动车组通信 :网络包系列化和低水平电动机总线延迟.

blocks.en: Appendix G Performance–Parameter Pareto Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录G 性能-参数 帕雷托分析

blocks.en: To assess the parameter efficiency of V-JEPA Policy and other baselines, we compare success rates and policy parameter counts across three simulation benchmarks and two real-world tasks. Figure 5 presents the results. Each panel includes the baselines evaluated in that setting and the base V-JEPA Policy, whose future-latent predictor and action expert are trained from scratch on downstream demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 为了评估V-JEPA政策和其他基线的参数效率,我们比较了成功率和政策参数对三个模拟基准和两个现实世界的任务的计算。 图5列出了结果。 每个小组都包括在该背景下评估的基线和基准V-JEPA政策,其未来相对的预测器和行动专家从头到尾接受下游示范培训。

blocks.en:
Each point represents a policy, with parameter count in billions on the horizontal axis and success rate on the vertical axis.
A policy is nondominated if no other compared policy achieves at least the same success rate using no more parameters, with a strict improvement in either quantity. Circled points identify these nondominated policies, which form the empirical Pareto frontier.
blocks.zh:
每个点代表政策,参数数以十亿计在水平轴上,成功率在垂直轴上.
如果与其他政策相比,没有一项政策至少能够使用更多的参数取得同样的成功率,同时在数量上均得到严格的改进,那么一项政策就不是占主导地位的。 圆点确定了这些非支配性政策,它们构成了经验性的帕雷托前沿.

blocks.en: The base V-JEPA Policy lies on the empirical Pareto frontier in all five settings among the compared methods. On LIBERO, it achieves 97.25% success, 1.15 percentage points below ImageWAM’s 98.4% while using one-fifth of its parameters. On RoboCasa-GR1, it achieves 50.92% success with 0.9B parameters, compared with 47.60% for the 3.0B GR00T N1.6. On the real-world tasks, it achieves 55% success on Table Cleanup and 35% on Saucer Racking; the latter matches FastWAM with 15% of its parameter count. These comparisons further demonstrate that predictive visual latents provide a foundation for effective WAM learning at a compact policy scale.
blocks.zh: V-JEPA政策的基础在于比较方法中所有五个环境中的经验性Pareto前沿。 在LIBERO上,它取得了97.25%的成功,比ImageWAM的98.4%低1.15个百分点,同时使用了它的五分之一参数. 在RoboCasa-GR1上,它以0.9B参数实现50.92%的成功率,而3.0B GR00T N1.6则达到47.60%. 在现实世界的任务上,它在Table Cleanup上取得了55%的成功,在Saucer Racking上取得了35%的成功;后者以15%的参数数匹配FastWAM. 这些比较进一步表明,预测的视觉潜力为在紧凑的政策规模下有效学习世界母亲运动奠定了基础。
